description.tr: Bağdat'ın kuruluş tarihini belirlemeye yardım eden Yahudi kökenli astronom; Latince'ye en çok çevrilen Arap astronomu || Yahudi asıllı Abbâsî müneccimi; Bağdat'ın kuruluş tarihini astrolojik hesaplarla belirledi. description.en: Jewish-origin astronomer who helped determine Baghdad's founding date; most translated Arabic astronomer into Latin || Helped select the astrological date for founding Baghdad; most widely translated Islamic astronomer into Latin || [Historiographical note] Jewish scholar who worked alongside Muslim colleagues; his Latin translations outnumber any other Islamic astronomer
